scenes.name: TWO CLOCKS
lines: Complex phases always commute: A then B is B then A.
复数相位总是交换的：先 A 后 B，等于先 B 后 A。
Promote the two clocks to unit quaternions. Our sample: one plus two i, and one plus two j, over root five.
把两只时钟提升为单位四元数。取一对样本：1 + 2i 与 1 + 2j，各除以 √5。
Up to rotation, three half-traces survive: x and y are one over root five, z is one fifth.
除去整体转动，只剩三个半迹：x 与 y 都是 1/√5，z 是 1/5。
The defect E, sixteen twenty-fifths, is the squared area between the axes, and U V minus V U has squared size four E.
交换子亏量 E = 16/25，是两根虚轴所夹面积的平方；UV − VU 的模方恰为 4E。

scenes.name: THE GRAM BODY
lines: E is the Gram determinant of the anchors one, U and V.
E 正是三个锚点 1、U、V 的格拉姆行列式。
The allowed triples fill a convex body whose skin is where the clocks commute.
允许的三元组填满一块凸体，它的表皮正是两只时钟交换的地方。
Lean checks the integer version: the normalized Gram determinant is never negative.
Lean 内核检验整数版本：归一化格拉姆行列式永不为负。
And the curvature identity: the Lie triple bracket returns the Gram area squared.
还有曲率恒等式：利雅三元括号恰好还原格拉姆面积平方。

scenes.name: FREE WORDS
lines: Integers refuse to commute too: take the six Hurwitz quaternions of norm five.
整数同样不肯交换：取六枚模方为 5 的赫维茨四元数。
One plus two i times one plus two j ends in plus four; reversed, in minus four.
(1 + 2i)(1 + 2j) 最后一位是 +4；换个次序，变成 −4。
Up to length three, 186 words turn the x and y axes into 186 different frames.
长度不超过 3 的 186 个词，把 x 轴与 y 轴转成 186 个互不相同的标架。
Lean checks: two reduced words that move both axes alike are equal, letter for letter.
Lean 内核检验：两个既约词若把两根轴转到同一处，就逐字母完全相同。

scenes.name: HEARING THE CLOCKS
lines: Now hide the axes: put U and V on the shell's clock edges, and keep only the energy levels.
现在把轴藏起来：球壳的时钟边乘上 U 与 V，只留下能级。
The shortest closed walks carry x, then z, then y, so the spectrum recovers all three, by a written argument.
最短的几类闭走依次携带 x、z、y，于是谱把三者全部还原：这是书面论证。
It is two copies of the scalar spectrum exactly when E is zero. You can hear non-commutativity.
双分量谱恰好是标量谱的两份拷贝，当且仅当 E = 0：非交换性听得出来。
Three determinant readings suffice, by an interval certificate. Two readings never could.
三个行列式读数就够了，由区间证书担保。两个读数永远不够。

scenes.name: ZEROS AS DICE
lines: Next: can Riemann zeros roll dice for a group integral?
下一个问题：黎曼零点能替群积分掷骰子吗？
At each zero, shell angles set the clocks; a fourth angle, u, is the test.
在每个零点上，球壳角度给出两只时钟；第四个角 u 是检验。
Keep the zero when u falls under the bar.
u 落在柱子下方，就保留这个零点。
Of the first 128 zeros, 16 pass, starting at numbers 8, 15, 28, 31, 38 and 50.
前 128 个零点中有 16 个通过，开头几个编号是 8、15、28、31、38、50。
Assuming classical R H, an external Lean proof, they become exact Haar samples, at the best density, one over two pi.
以经典 RH（外部 Lean 证明）为前提，它们成为精确的哈尔样本，密度取到最优的 1/(2π)。

scenes.name: TWENTY-TWO FREQUENCIES
lines: The shell's twenty-two frequencies feed the whole Standard Model group: four, two, and sixteen.
球壳的 22 个频率喂满整个标准模型群：4 个、2 个、16 个。
Group integrals rest on Schur orthogonality, which Lean checks for every compact group.
群积分以舒尔正交关系为基石；Lean 内核对任意紧群检验了它。
Built on it, the commutator's average character is one over n plus one. We recompute the first four.
以它为基础，交换子的平均特征标是 1/(n + 1)。屏幕上重算前四项。
Still, the zeros give a sampler, not the dynamics: couplings and actions are inputs.
但零点给出的是采样器，不是动力学：耦合与作用量仍是外部输入。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter two.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第二章
